description: Shared Rust/WASM vector for the command builders' no-program refusal (#376). Every case is a line the core must refuse instead of building a record: `code` is CommandError::code (the WASM error's `kind`) and `message` is the core's Display text. `builder` is `posix` (action_from_command), `powershell` (action_from_powershell_command) or `argv` (action_from_argv, whose `argv` is the token array and `raw` the optional display text; `command` is unused). Written by hand from docs/policy-seam.md §Command lines that run no program; never regenerate it from program output.
